notes.title: Sproggiwood Savage Patch (1.2) is Now Available!
notes.content:
Rejoice! Rejoice!

The Savage Patch (1.2) is here, featuring Savage Mode, a brutal new difficulty level with all new monster behavior. Also included: 10 new achievements and 12 new class-specific items. Aaannnddd... the Sproggiwood Original Soundtrack is now available!

[h1]1.2 Update[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New feature[/b]: Savage Mode, a brutal difficulty level featuring new monster behavior for all the monsters!
[*][b]New feature[/b]: 10 new achievements!
[*][b]New feature[/b]: 12 class-specific items!
[*][b]New feature[/b]: The Sproggiwood Original Soundtrack is now available. A new edition, Sproggiwood Enlightened Edition, includes both the game and the soundtrack.
[*][b]New feature[/b]: A "Phone" layout option for small screens is now available.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Surma is tougher on all difficulty levels.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: The Merchant Quarter civic boost discount was reduced from 15% to 10% per level.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Rumakko's Urn now works as intended.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Performance and memory usage are better.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: All target pickers now respect remapped key bindings.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: The Dungeon Defeat and Death screens now respect remapped key bindings.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: The compass no longer detaches from the UI.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Graphic artifacts no longer appear while resizing the screen.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: The UI no longer occasionally corrupts while buying civic boosts.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Consumables display correctly in storage.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: The text spacing on gold rewards is now correct.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Wizard hats fit even better.
[/list]

notes.title: Sproggiwood Yuletide Patch (1.1) is Live!
notes.content:
Happy holidays!

The Yuletide patch is here, featuring full controller support and a Yuletide quest from... the Horned One. So eat, drink, be merry, and civilize Sproggiwood!

[h1]1.1 Update[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New feature[/b]: Sproggiwood now has full controller support!
[*][b]New feature[/b]: Key and button bindings are fully remappable. Additionally, bindings appear in the UI based on your mapping and whether you're using a controller or keyboard and mouse.
[*][b]New feature[/b]: It's Yuletide in Sproggiwood! A new villager has arrived with a limited-time quest from the Horned One.
[*][b]New feature[/b]: The decorating UI has been greatly improved.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Monsters damaging each other doesn't disqualify you from earning the "Quasi-Pacifist" achievement.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: The "Et Tu, Cloghead?" achievement now triggers properly.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Village monsters no longer roam into the river.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: The vampire powers [i]Feeeeeeed![/i] and [i]Drain Life[/i] proc weapon effects properly.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: The minimap now updates when you're hasted.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Frostball no longer causes issues.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Sapius no longer occasionally gives too much stamina.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Player animations no longer play behind other animations.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Goatfolk under your control now charge enemies.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Consumables display correctly in storage.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: The UI no longer occasionally disappears while you're decorating.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Decorations now appear exactly where you place them.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Building upgrade and downgrade options only appear when you can actually upgrade or downgrade a building. 
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Wizard hats fit better.
[/list]

notes.title: Sproggiwood 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Hi there!
We posted an update that includes a couple useful new usability features and some small bug fixes.

[h1]1.0.1[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New feature:[/b] The "r" key now toggles between "Run" and "Walk" modes. Running lets you hold down movement keys to move repetitively.
[*][b]New feature[/b]: A full screen mode option was added to the Settings menu.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Alt+Tab no longer freezes the game.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Unlocked accessories no longer apply their effects unless they are equipped.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Civilizer-in-Chief and Civilizer-in-Chiefest achievements are now unlockable.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Silence the Opposition achievement no longer gets improperly unlocked.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Summon yeti now always costs the appropriate amount of stamina.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: Vampire's Drain Life now affects enthralled monsters.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: "s" key now walks south.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: VSync is no longer disabled in town. This was causing unnecessary power usage issues on laptops.
[*][b]Fix[/b]: The Haunted Mansion's tile size was increased from 2x2 to 2x3.
[/list]
